Summary.en: Stores a JSON-serialized value (from another element or object) into a hidden field.
Summary.de: Speichert einen JSON-serialisierten Wert (aus einem anderen Element oder Objekt) in einem versteckten Feld.
Summary.it: Memorizza un valore serializzato in JSON (da un altro elemento o oggetto) in un campo nascosto.

Parameter.Path: The optional dotted path leading to the object, starting from the tagged element, which's Property is to be set. If left empty, the tagged element itself is the target (e.g. to set innerHTML).
Parameter.Property: The name of the property to set.
Parameter.ToSet: The object to set the Property to.
